search_queries: Payment API HTTP 500 database connection timeouts
plan.rationale: Sudden failure with database timeouts. The window starts three hours before detection to include recent deployments and ends at resolution.

evidence.description: 214 HikariPool connection acquisition timeouts between 14:05 and 15:10.
Payment API v4.18.2 deployed to production 34 minutes before detection.
Past Payment API failure caused by database connection pool exhaustion from unclosed sessions in the retry handler.
Payment API depends directly on the payment-db-prod-01 database.
Firewall rule update on the edge load balancer, not on the Payment API path.
Earlier Payment API incident with HTTP 500 errors and connection pool starvation.
Database active connections stayed below 45% of max_connections during the incident.

investigation_summary: The failures started shortly after the deployment of Payment API v4.18.2 and match a past RCA on the same service with the same failure pattern.
observed_patterns: Database connection acquisition timeouts started 7 minutes after the v4.18.2 deployment.
HTTP 500 responses and latency increased in the same window.
The same failure pattern appeared on Payment API in November 2025.

hypotheses.candidate_root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by connections not being released in Payment API v4.18.2.
reasons: Connection acquisition timeouts began shortly after the v4.18.2 deployment.
A past RCA on the same service describes the same failure pattern.
The database itself was not saturated, which points to the application side.
recommended_validation: Compare database connection usage before and after v4.18.2.
Review the code changes in v4.18.2 for connections that are not closed.
confidence_reasons: Change on the affected service inside the window, before detection (+2).
Past RCA with the same cause on the same service (+2).
CMDB dependency confirms the technical path (+1).

hypotheses.candidate_root_cause: Capacity limit reached on the payment-db-prod-01 database, independent of the release.
reasons: The timeouts are on the database connection path.
Payment API depends directly on this database.
recommended_validation: Check database CPU and active sessions for the incident window.
confidence_reasons: CMDB dependency confirms the technical path (+1).
Contradicting evidence EV-007 lowers the level by one band: LOW.

not_checked: No database CPU or session metrics were available for the incident window.
Logs from the secondary instances used during mitigation were not checked.
suggested_workaround: Temporarily raise the connection pool limit and roll back to v4.18.1 if timeouts return.
